research:
SOURCES (second pass, 22 web searches): Yahoo Sports G4 live/recap, MLB.com (rainout schedule; Rays stick with Martinez; Martinez G4 recap; ALCS expert picks), CBS Sports (rainout pitching plans; ALCS expert picks), ESPN (betting odds story, game page, BPI predictor), Fox Sports G5 game page, sportbook.ag G5 preview, therx.com, galvnews/Reuters, Las Vegas Sports Betting props, BettingPros, Covers, Hard Rock Bet, FanDuel Research, Kalshi, scoresandodds, plus MLB StatsAPI and Open-Meteo. WebFetch still fails DNS, so quotes come from search snippets.
1) SERIES/GAME 4: Game 4 was rained out Fri 10/16, played Sat 10/17 8:08 PM ET: Rays won 7-3 Sat, series tied 2-2. Series: tied 2-2 after TB's 7-3 Game 4 win (TB 11 H; Martinez 5.1 IP 1 ER; G4 total 10 went over 6.5). G1 CLE 7-3 at TB, G2 TB 3-1 at TB, G3 CLE 3-2 at CLE. No off days remain (G6 Mon at TB, G7 Tue at TB). MLB lists G5 Sun 5 PM ET (TBS/truTV); one Fox listing said 9:08 PM.
2) STARTERS (MLB.com/CBS/Yahoo pre-G4 reports; StatsAPI probables not yet posted): TB RHP Drew Rasmussen on 6 days' rest (Rays kept Nick Martinez for G4 instead of moving him up) vs CLE LHP Parker Messick on 4 days' rest (Gavin Williams lined up for G6).
3) RASMUSSEN 2026: 30 GS, 172.0 IP, 2.67 ERA, 2.81 FIP, 3.21 xFIP, 0.91 WHIP, K 26.0% (174/669), BB 4.8%, .199 opp AVG, 4.97 fWAR-type WAR (StatsAPI). Per start: 17.2 outs (sd 3.4), 5.8 K (sd 2.7), 4.2 H (sd 2.1), 88.7 pitches; >=17 outs in 60% of starts. Post: ALDS vs NYY 8.0 IP 1 H 0 ER 10 K; ALCS G1 vs CLE 6.0 IP 8 H 2 ER 7 K 0 BB (91 pitches). Splits: vs LHB .568 OPS, vs RHB .510.
4) MESSICK 2026 (rookie): 32 GS, 186.1 IP, 2.56 ERA, 3.07 FIP, 3.36 xFIP, 1.06 WHIP, K 25.8% (193/747), BB 6.6%. Per start 17.5 outs (sd 3.0), 6.0 K, 4.7 H, 92 pitches. POSTSEASON leash much shorter: 4.1 IP/87 pitches (2 ER, 2 BB), 2.1 IP/65 pitches (4 BB), ALCS G2 at TB 5.0 IP/82 pitches 0 ER 6 H 2 BB 3 K -> 13, 7, 15 outs; 8 BB in 11.2 postseason IP. Last regular start 3.0 IP.
5) OFFENSES (StatsAPI): TB 4.54 R/G, .728 OPS, 18.8% K, but only .679 OPS vs LHP (18.1% K) vs .752 vs RHP, so lefty Messick takes away TB's best split. CLE 4.19 R/G, .696 OPS, 20.8% K; vs RHP .706 OPS (20.6% K), so Rasmussen faces a below-average lineup that he held to 2 ER in G1. Postseason before G4: CLE .678 OPS (9 G, 36 R), TB .578 OPS (7 G, 23 R). In ALCS G3 the Rays struck out 13 times vs Gavin Williams (9 K) and the pen; in G4 TB broke out for 11 H and 7 R.
6) PITCHING/BULLPENS: team ERA TB 3.70 (1.14 WHIP), CLE 3.77; postseason staff ERA before G4 CLE 2.77, TB 2.72. Bullpen usage last 3 games: CLE in G4 used Armstrong 13 pitches, Griffin 44, Espino 22, Herrin 14, Cecconi 22, Festa 21, Cantillo 15 (Herrin/Cecconi/Espino also pitched G1-G3); TB in G4 used Martinez 79, Peralta 9, Seymour 29 (3rd outing of series), Kelly 16, Booser 4, Baker 12, while Wells, Matz and Sulser are rested. CLE's high-leverage trio (Cade Smith, Hunter Gaddis, Erik Sabrowski) last pitched G3 Thu (Smith 1.1 IP/18 pitches). Rays pen: Peralta (G2 starter) relieved in G4; Seymour has pitched G1, G2, G4.
7) INJURIES (ESPN): CLE - Rhys Hoskins (10-day IL, back), Colin Holderman (wrist), Andrew Walters (elbow). TB - Shane McClanahan (forearm), Edwin Uceta, Gavin Lux, Jonathan Heasley, Jacob Melton out. No new G5 lineup news found (search budget).
8) WEATHER/PARK: ESPN forecast for Progressive Field ~63F at first pitch, 0% precip, gusts to 17 mph; G4 night was 46F. Cool October air suppresses carry. Regular-season series TB 5-1; totals 5,1,4,14,3,1 (5 of 6 under 6.5). ALCS totals 10, 4, 5, 10 (Under 6.5 hit 7 of 10 TB-CLE meetings in 2026).
9) MARKET/MODELS: DraftKings closers (ESPN pickcenter): G1 TB -163/CLE +145, total 6.5 (o-115); G2 TB -131/CLE +117, 6.5 (o-117); G3 CLE -132/TB +117, 6.5 (o-114); G4 TB -108/CLE -104, 6.5 (o-117/u-103). Every game closed 6.5 with the Over shaded, so an Under 6.5 near -105 is the expected G5 price. ESPN Matchup Predictor (BPI) for G5: CLE 52.1%, TB 47.9%. ESPN/Fox series odds made CLE the AL pennant favorite at 2-1 (pre-G4). Covers/SI/Yahoo/RAW CHILI published G4 picks (Rays ML -114/-116 widely; total 6.5 o-108/u-112), but G5 expert picks were not yet indexed.
GAME 5 QUOTES FOUND: Fox Sports G5 page: TB -122 / CLE -110 ML, total 6.5 (Over -122 / Under -110), book not named. sportbook.ag G5 preview: TB +105 / CLE -125, total 6.5 (pick: CLE -125 + Under 6.5; its text cites stale names like Eflin, so it is weak). No-vig CLE: Fox 0.488, sportbook 0.533, avg 0.51. Under 6.5: Fox no-vig 0.488; ESPN listed 6.5 at -110/-110 (0.50), but that may be the G4 line. Run line (ESPN CLE +1.5 -193 / TB -1.5 +158; scoresandodds DK +159, FD +168, MGM +165 on TB -1.5) could not be confirmed as G5 numbers, so the +1.5 leg was dropped. No G5 pitcher props were posted anywhere I could find (latest: Rasmussen G1 K 5.5 -115/-115, outs 17.5 o-130/u-110; Messick G2 K 4.5 o-150/u+115), so all props were dropped.
